metadata.title: A new runtime must own execution, memory and device integration on a distinct OS, model or hardware stack.

applicability.scope: Independent runtime bring-up across OS, model format, device and backend boundaries.
applicability.input_contract: Actual hardware, model, engine, script and flags, benchmark, acceptance criteria, current diagnosis, permitted changes and budget.
applicability.produced_artifact: Operator/capability map, minimal native execution path, end-to-end parity and resource measurements.
applicability.refusal_point: Record missing evidence or an exhausted search budget and identify the smallest discriminating test before declaring success.
